policy: Exact-component primary-source data only; retains previous adoptions and distinguishes estimates, model-dependent results, uncertainty conventions and equivalent radius definitions. No Info article changes.

hip-75695.note: A radius from interferometry; B radius from surface-brightness/color relation, not its noisier direct interferometric diameter. A temperature from flux/diameter; B temperature and luminosity depend on atmospheric/BC models. Masses and age are evolutionary estimates; age assumes coeval formation. Component V is a flux decomposition with an adopted 503-nm contrast. Uses original Hipparcos parallax 28.60 +/- 0.69 mas, not the current catalog distance.

mass_solar.scope: MAP estimates and 95 percent highest-density posterior intervals, not Gaussian one-sigma errors. SB1 masses are conditional on both priors; secondary bounds use products of marginal bounds, not independent credible intervals. Dubhe mass solution is not adopted because of conflicting current primary mass; RV solution remains useful.

age_gyr.scope: Shared coeval binary isochrone age, not independently measured for each component.

spectral_type.scope: Broad spectral class from this component solution; no luminosity class inferred.

apparent_mag.scope: Johnson V inferred using the observed 503-nm contrast and integrated V; errors adopted by the authors.

hip-30883.note: Preferred C4 identification Aa=narrow-lined A2, Ab=broad-lined A1; alternatives exist. Temperatures are conservative adopted estimates, particularly the Be star temperature from classification. Inner luminosities and polar radii are rough rotating-star models with no formal errors. Polar radii are preserved here and are not adopted as spherical catalog radii. Model age is approximate and conditional. The catalog wide Ba/Bb pair is outside this three-star solution; no systemic velocity or physical measurements are copied to that pair. This adoption supersedes the older single-source atmosphere/mass/radius/luminosity estimates; earlier measurements and their scope remain in retained source records.

temperature_k.scope: Conservative temperature estimate from disentangled spectra with continuum and third-light systematics.

age_gyr.scope: Approximate common 100 Myr age from rotating-star tracks; no formal confidence interval. Applies to the confirmed close triple only.

luminosity_solar.scope: Rough individual bolometric luminosity; no formal uncertainty published.

radius_solar.section: Equivalent spherical radius from adopted luminosity and uniform temperature
radius_solar.scope: Stefan-Boltzmann equivalent spherical radius, not a measured radius or the published polar radius of the rotating-star fit. Large temperature/model uncertainty applies; no independent error claimed.

absolute_mag.scope: Approximate individual Johnson V from H-band flux ratio transferred to V; no formal error reported. Absolute V uses the current adopted catalog distance without extinction correction; the paper used a different orbital distance.

apparent_mag.scope: Approximate individual Johnson V from H-band flux ratio transferred to V; no formal error reported. Absolute V uses the current adopted catalog distance without extinction correction; the paper used a different orbital distance.

metallicity_dex.reason: Gaia DR3 3372552842178783616 is the unresolved source already identified in the component audit. Its single-star atmosphere metallicity is not a resolved Aa1 abundance; retained with its original error and provenance as source evidence.
